title: RedteamInput
description: Input for adversarial red-team analysis of a meeting transcript. Supports two modes: transcript-only (broad risk scan) or transcript + focus (targeted stress-test of a specific idea or proposal). All optional fields improve analysis quality when provided.

transcript.description: Full meeting transcript text. Must include enough content for meaningful analysis (minimum 50 characters). Speaker-attributed transcripts produce higher-confidence output.

context.description: Background context for the analysis: project history, market situation, org dynamics, or any information that helps interpret the transcript. Improves risk identification accuracy. Example: 'Series B startup, 18-month runway, entering enterprise market for the first time.'

audience.description: Who will read this analysis. Adjusts language and detail level. Examples: 'CEO', 'engineering team', 'board of directors', 'product council'.

risk_tolerance.description: Caller's risk tolerance. 'low' = flag everything, conservative thresholds. 'medium' = balanced, flag material risks. 'high' = only flag serious and likely risks. Defaults to medium behavior if omitted.

focus_idea.description: A specific thesis, proposal, or decision to stress-test. When provided, the analysis focuses failure modes and adversarial questions on this idea rather than scanning broadly. Triggers transcript_plus_focus mode. Example: 'We should launch in APAC by Q4 using existing infrastructure.'

focus_questions.description: Specific questions to investigate. Each should be a concrete concern or angle to probe. Triggers transcript_plus_focus mode. Example items: 'Can the current payments stack handle multi-currency?', 'Do we have regulatory clearance for the target markets?'

constraints.description: Known constraints the analysis must respect. Failure modes and recommendations will be evaluated against these. Examples: 'Budget capped at $500K', 'Must ship before regulatory deadline March 1', 'Cannot hire additional headcount this quarter'.
